# Agents

Read in this order:

1. [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)
2. [RULES.md](RULES.md)
3. [catalog.json](catalog.json)
4. The component markdown for the piece you change. For a theme change, read [tokens/schema.json](tokens/schema.json).

For any UI, social, thumbnail, or motion task, follow [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Rules

1. Read AGENTS.md, then RULES.md, then catalog.json, then the component doc for the piece you change.
   Why: An agent that skips this order invents a piece that is not in the system.
   Doc: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)

2. The repo is the source of truth. Figma mirrors it.
   Why: Two sources that both lead will drift.
   Doc: [RULES.md](RULES.md)

3. Components use semantic tokens such as color.action.primary.
   Why: A theme can restyle every screen without a component edit.
   Doc: [RULES.md](RULES.md)

4. Do not rename a role in tokens/schema.json.
   Why: Every reader keys off those names.
   Doc: [tokens/schema.json](tokens/schema.json)

5. A theme supplies values only. It cannot replace a component.
   Why: A brand fills the kit. It does not fork the kit.
   Doc: [RULES.md](RULES.md)

6. Gray steps stay 0 through 900.
   Why: A brand fills the steps. It does not add a step.
   Doc: [RULES.md](RULES.md)

7. Status hues stay success, warning, error, and info.
   Why: A brand may change the color. It may not change the meaning.
   Doc: [RULES.md](RULES.md)

8. Tap targets use size.tap.
   Why: One target size keeps controls easy to hit.
   Doc: [RULES.md](RULES.md)

9. Harbor is a test theme, not a brand.
   Why: It exists to prove a second accent restyles the system.
   Doc: [themes/harbor.json](themes/harbor.json)

10. Every component has a purpose, props, when to use, and when not to use.
   Why: Agents choose from those facts.
   Doc: [catalog.json](catalog.json)

11. One primary action per screen.
   Why: A screen with two primary buttons hides the main action.
   Doc: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)

12. Chunk a screen into small groups.
   Why: A person can hold only a few choices at once.
   Doc: [RULES.md](RULES.md)

13. Prefer a documented prop over a new component.
   Why: Fewer pieces stay easier to use correctly.
   Doc: [RULES.md](RULES.md)

14. Icons go through icons/. Lucide is the default set.
   Why: The icon set can be swapped without rewriting components.
   Doc: [RULES.md](RULES.md)

15. Run build:tokens and build:catalog, and commit both outputs.
   Why: People and agents then read the same values.
   Doc: [README.md](README.md)

16. Do not hand-edit catalog.json or AGENTS.md.
   Why: Both files are generated. A hand edit will fail the check.
   Doc: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md)

17. Schema and raw-value checks block.
   Why: A broken theme or a raw color should not merge.
   Doc: [RULES.md](RULES.md)

18. The first live surface is web, and the first export is CSS variables.
   Why: Social, thumbnail, video, and Tailwind wait until this base is the source.
   Doc: [BRIEF.md](BRIEF.md)
